content: In the preface of the K. al-Mafāḥiṣ (MS Majlis 10196 f. 35a) Ibn Turka describes the rational-theoretical approach that does not swerve from the highway of intuitive all-comprehensiveness as the most persuasive of the methods current among the nations; Melvin-Koushki reads this as Ibn Turka calling mystical-philosophical synthesis the standard intellectual approach of his day.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, K. al-Mafāḥiṣ, preface, MS Majlis 10196 f. 35a
